summary: Amazon.com, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of eight series of senior unsecured notes—floating rate notes tied to Compounded SOFR plus a spread, and fixed-rate notes with various maturities and coupon rates. Terms such as price per share, premium, or implied value are not applicable; this is a debt issuance, not an equity event or special situation. The notes rank equally with existing senior unsecured debt, are not listed on any exchange, and have no sinking fund. Proceeds go to Amazon for general corporate purposes. The offering is underwritten by major banks. No special-situation event—routine shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5).
